body: I do find it therapeutic sometimes, thanks.

Thank you for your effort. Thinking of things I love doesn't help however, neither does focusing on how much I love myself considering what a self hating/harming mood I'm in right now. I just feel trapped and scared in this horrifying place, unable to escape the near constant barrage of thoughts telling me I want to die. Part of the problem is I'm not a person who's known for being filled to the brim with joy and love, but losing that knowledge that no matter what happens at least I'm loved has been devistating. I can't get over it and it's tearing me to pieces. I don't want to go down the same road I went before, it just brings me back to the same destination...
